title: Dispensers tip over easily and top is impossible to wash; otherwise it works as designed
text:
Dispensers tip over easily and top is impossible to wash; otherwise it works as designed. This set comes with two dispensers, a funnel, and a rack for the dispensers. I do like the small footprint of this. However, the triangular design causes the dispensers to tip over easily when they are out of the rack. I almost tipped them over three times. The design also makes the container difficult to wash except with a tiny bottle brush. The top is impossible to wash in my opinion and I do not like that. I personally would like to be able to wash everything periodically.

The top screws on via one turn, which I also do not like because it is never tight. Nevertheless, nothing leaked out, so the set is functional and works as designed. The top has a great flow as well and opens automatically as the oil or vinegar is dispensed. Despite its functionality, after having tried this, it works and is stylish but is not designed sturdy enough for my tastes.

The current price of $17.95 ($18.89 minus 5%) is competitive for this ensemble.
